## Problem Sets

Problem sets are distributed as `.qmd` files along with their rendered `.html` form. You should edit the provided `.qmd` file and render to `.html` when submitting the assignment. Additional files (e.g. datasets) are located in sub-folders. For convenience, all the combined files are also distributed as a `.zip` compressed archive.

Links become active when each assignment is released.

## Exams

Both exams are **in person**, closed-book, pen-and-paper examinations involving both theory questions and practical interpretation of sample code and results.

- **Midterm:** in class on Wednesday, October 28, covering material through Week 7.
- **Final:** during the university exam period, December 11-17. The date, time and room are assigned by the registrar and will be posted here once available. The final covers material from the full semester.
